replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I rarely get anxious about math because I've used it practically in my hobbies and work. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like ChatGPT to explain basic algebra concepts. It helped me understand step-by-step solutions without overwhelming me. replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; zero, one solution; negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a). This method works for all second-order equations.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. These points could be maxima, minima, or points of inflection depending on the second derivative test.
